Note, then, this type of experiment: let a silver coin be hollowed out and placed upon water, such that it floats upon it like a ship. Then, hold a piece of genuine unicorn horn <note>original: "unicornu"</note> in such a way that it does not actually touch it, but is as close to it as possible. The unicorn horn, by its spiritual power, will repel the coin from itself so that it flees, just like a duck that, while swimming through the water, flees when it notices the snare of the fowler aiming a leaden pellet at it.

Conversely, nature loves and follows in a marvelous way that which is similar to itself, as is evident from this example: Place a piece of pure and unadulterated bread into water, in a bowl filled with water, so that the bread floats on the water. <summary>This page describes experiments demonstrating the "spiritual power" of unicorn horn, illustrating how it repels materials through an antipathy of nature while attracting those with which it shares an affinity.</summary>
